units.policy: Access controls are implemented that limit the information to authorized personnel.
units.why: It implements "controles de acceso que limiten la información únicamente al personal autorizado" for AI systems, an access-control security rule, P126.

units.passage: adecuadas para proteger los sistemas de IA contra amenazas y ataques cibernéticos
units.policy: Adequate measures are maintained to protect AI systems against cyber threats and attacks.
units.why: It says "se mantendrán medidas adecuadas para proteger los sistemas de IA contra amenazas y ataques cibernéticos", a security control for AI systems, P126.

units.passage: Approach deployment thoughtfully, ensure agents are properly sandboxed and clearly scoped in what data they can access and what actions they can take, and seek guidance before going live.
units.why: 'ensure agents are properly sandboxed and clearly scoped in what data they can access' is a security control on AI agents: P126.

units.passage: Any bot you use for university purposes should be sandboxed, meaning it should operate with the minimum access needed and have no connection to USU data systems unless that access has been explicitly reviewed and approved.
units.why: 'Any bot you use for university purposes should be sandboxed' with minimum access and no connection to USU data without approval: P126 (access limits on AI agents).

units.passage: Whether you are looking to utilize AI tools for your work or are planning to build your own GenAI tool, consult with the Information Security Office about security measures that should be in place to ensure your AI model, training data and generated content are protected from unauthorized access or malicious activity
units.why: "consult with the Information Security Office about security measures" to protect model, training data and content from unauthorized access is a security-controls rule, P126.
